p: offered sacrifices unto the God of: By this he signified both that he worshipped the true God, and that he kept in his heart the possession of that land from which need drove him at that time.
go down with thee into Egypt: Conducting you by my power.
bring thee up again: In your posterity.
put his hand upon thine eyes: Shall shut your eyes when you die: which belongs to him that was most dear or chief of the kindred.
shepherds: He was not ashamed of his father and kindred, though they were of base condition.
abomination unto the Egyptians: God permits the world to hate his own, so they will forsake the filth of the world, and cling to him.
